Subject: Quick ask — GCP marketplace listing + pricing exception for POC

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at ClearOps is excited to move to a POC on GCP. We have a short procurement window and need the product listed on GCP Marketplace with co-sell eligibility. Our procurement lead flagged the marketplace listing price needs to reflect a 35% discount for the first 6 months to match internal budget constraints (POC scope: 3 months, potential expansion after).

Can Redwood approve a one-time marketplace pricing exception for this POC? If so, we can sign the GCP co-sell form and start the onboarding steps this week. I attached our POC requirements and budget note.

Key asks:
- 35% off published GCP marketplace price for first 6 months (POC)
- Co-sell listing enabled and reseller terms shared
- Agreement to standard GCP marketplace commission handling

Procurement contact: procurement@clearops.com

Appreciate a quick turnaround — their legal team is moving fast.

Best,
Sarah Li
Head of Cloud Partnerships, ClearOps
(sarah.li@clearops.com)

Subject: RE: Fwd: Quick ask — GCP marketplace listing + pricing exception for POC

Rishi —

Quick analysis after running the numbers:
- Published GCP marketplace price: $12,000/mo (standard sku for targeted capacity).
- 35% discount -> effective $7,800/mo. For 6 months that’s $46,800 revenue.
- Our variable cost estimate (GPU run-hours + infra) ~ 30% of topline; gross margin falls to ~40% for the promo period.

Options I recommend:
1) Approve a limited promotional discount of 30% (vs 35%) for the first 3 months; then 15% for months 4–6. Limits revenue impact and gives time to prove value.
2) Approve the 35% for 6 months only if ClearOps agrees to a 12-month minimum committed term after POC (auto-convert clause).

For either option, we'll need Deal Desk sign-off for a marketplace exception and a signed GCP co-sell form that lists the promotional SKU. I've attached a draft price_breakdown (redwood_price_breakdown_q1.xlsx).

Marissa Cole
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_price_breakdown_q1.xlsx

Subject: RE: Fwd: Quick ask — GCP marketplace listing + pricing exception for POC

Rishi / Marissa —

GCP marketplace notes:
- Enabling co-sell listing is straightforward provided we submit the SKU with the promotional price and a co-sell justification (POC -> strategic customer).
- Google requires a one-time co-sell review; I can file the packet but need Deal Desk approval to list the promotional SKU and to accept the commission handling (we'll still remit standard marketplace commissions).
- The GCP co-sell form (filled) is attached. They also often expect a plan for adoption metrics post-POC (we should include usage targets: 50k tokens/day or equivalent).

My preference: accept Marissa option #1 (30% then 15%) to preserve margin and keep momentum. If Rishi wants to push to 35% for speed, we need a signed auto-convert term.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

Can you approve a one-time marketplace pricing exception for ClearOps? Summary: ClearOps requests 35% off the published GCP SKU for first 6 months for a POC. Marissa proposes a compromise (30% for months 1–3, 15% for months 4–6). Karthik confirms co-sell steps and has the GCP form ready.

Impact / ask:
- Revenue (6mo): ~$46k if 35% — less with Marissa's reduced structure.

I need a short approval email we can forward to ClearOps and the GCP team by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks — Rishi
